data.narrative:
Blykalla, a Series B nuclear energy company founded by Janne Wallenius and Peter Szakalos, has raised $60M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws from a broader Nuclear Energy sector peer set comprising 3 public companies (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 8 private firms including Oklo, X-Energy, Nano Nuclear Energy, Fuse Energy, and Aalo Atomics.

A stage-progression methodology was applied, using the $60M total raised as a valuation proxy and applying a 1.9x multiplier typical of Series B-to-next-stage advancement. This method is well-suited to early-stage venture contexts where comparable transaction multiples are sparse. The calculation yields $114M as the implied valuation. A peer-median approach was not executable; while four same-sector peers exist, the narrow filters for identical stage, adjacent stage, or similar valuation tier produced fewer than three datapoints, making a statistically reliable median estimate infeasible. Applying an all-sector median would introduce unacceptable sector-agnostic bias.

The triangulated range is $97M (low), $114M (median), and $131M (high), derived from single-method analysis with standard confidence bounds. This range reflects early-stage financing patterns but carries material uncertainty around capital efficiency relative to underfunded Nuclear Energy comparables and execution risk inherent to the sector. Additional validation would require broader private market transaction data or management guidance on path to Series C.
